zh: 我以为很困难，结果竟然很容易。
old_en: I thought it was very difficult, but it turned out to be surprisingly easy.
new_en: I thought it would be hard, but it turned out to be easy.

zh: 我以为这家店有优惠，结果竟然没打折。
old_en: I thought the store had a discount, but it turned out there was none.
new_en: I thought the store had a discount, but it didn't.

zh: 我以为今天人多，结果竟然没几个人。
old_en: I thought there would be many people today, but it turned out there weren't many.
new_en: I thought there would be lots of people, but there weren't many.

zh: 我以为他是本地人，结果他上个月才搬来。
old_en: I thought he was a local, but it turned out he moved here last month.
new_en: I thought he was from here, but he just moved last month.

zh: 我以为手机坏了，结果只是没电了。
old_en: I thought the phone was broken, but it turned out it just needed charging.
new_en: I thought the phone was broken, but it just needed charging.

zh: 我以为这个病很严重，结果只是小感冒。
old_en: I thought the illness was serious, but it turned out to be just a minor cold.
new_en: I thought the illness was serious, but it was just a cold.

zh: 我以为面试会很难，结果比想象中顺利。
old_en: I thought the interview would be difficult, but it turned out to be easier than expected.
new_en: I thought the interview would be hard, but it went well.

zh: 我以为电影票会很贵，结果比想象中便宜。
old_en: I thought the movie ticket would be expensive, but it turned out to be cheaper.
new_en: I thought the movie ticket would be expensive, but it was cheap.

zh: 我以为做不出来，结果竟然做对了。
old_en: Turned out, I got it right despite not thinking I could.
new_en: I thought I couldn't do it, but I got it right.

zh: 我以为今天会下雨，结果是个大晴天。
old_en: It turned out to be a sunny day despite my expectation.
new_en: I thought it would rain today, but it was sunny.

zh: 我以为考试很难，结果题目很简单。
old_en: I thought the exam would be difficult, but it turned out the questions were very easy.
new_en: I thought the exam would be hard, but the questions were easy.

zh: 我以为钱包丢了，结果在包里找到了。
old_en: Turn out, the result was that I found the wallet in the bag.
new_en: I thought I lost my wallet, but I found it in my bag.

zh: 我以为钱包没带，结果在裤子口袋里找到了。
old_en: I thought I hadn't brought my wallet, but it turned out to be in my pants pocket.
new_en: I thought I didn't bring my wallet, but I found it in my pants pocket.

zh: 我以为他不同意，结果他同意了。
old_en: Turn out, he agreed despite my assumption.
new_en: I thought he wouldn't agree, but he did.

zh: 我以为这次他会迟到，结果他提前到了。
old_en: Turn out, he arrived early.
new_en: I thought he would be late, but he arrived early.

zh: 我以为他今天会加班，结果他请假了。
old_en: I thought he would work overtime today, but it turned out he took a leave.
new_en: I thought he would work overtime today, but he took a leave.

zh: 我以为这个项目要花一个月，结果十天就完成了。
old_en: The project turned out to be completed in just ten days.
new_en: I thought the project would take a month, but it only took ten days.

zh: 我以为那家店还开着，结果早就关门了。
old_en: I thought the store was still open, but it turned out to have closed early.
new_en: I thought the store was still open, but it had already closed.

zh: 我以为他感冒了，结果他只是嗓子疼。
old_en: Turn out, he just had a sore throat.
new_en: I thought he had a cold, but he just had a sore throat.

zh: 我以为这道菜不好吃，结果很好吃。
old_en: The dish turned out to be very delicious, not as I expected.
new_en: I thought the dish wouldn't taste good, but it was delicious.
